claim: After editing spec text mid-review, re-read every rule the edit touches before posting it, and review your own new text as hard as anyone else's: check each cited rule number, optional versus mandatory fields, and absolute claims such as 'no round trip'.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: about seven review rounds each found defects the author had just introduced (a wrong rule citation, an optional field that was mandatory elsewhere, an over-strong claim, abandon versus successor contradicting itself).
